entry.title: Söyembikä Tower
entry.note: Attributed cached OSM way228963085 for Q2166466, captured2026-09-27T16:21:24.079Z, establishes the lower18.02 by12.88m envelope and anchor[49.105181097,55.800475854]. Actual north-up satellite pixels inspected2026-10-09 confirm the tower beside the palace gates and the west/east passage direction. Heading−1.335984319155rad maps native+Z west/slightly south and+X north/slightly east. The published north wall reinforcement resolves the otherwise symmetric half-turn; the authored NE lean is transformed from geographic coordinates. Approximate2m position and5° angular uncertainty cover generalized outline, roof displacement and photo-fitted projections. The museum reference GLB was inspected only as uncalibrated cross-sections: its broad rectangular lower pylons support rejecting the draft square assumption, but its dimensions are not treated as surveyed. The accepted lower source envelope fits the mapped frame; recorded140/147m² public figures remain an unresolved dimensional interpretation, not a reason to stretch the original square invisibly. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
